title: Implement canonical /wiki command router
summary: Implement the core `/wiki bootstrap`, `/wiki status`, `/wiki resume`, and `/wiki config` user command surface while preserving legacy command shims.

goal.outcome: Users have canonical `/wiki bootstrap`, `/wiki status`, `/wiki resume`, and `/wiki config` entrypoints with legacy command compatibility and no extra agent-facing bootstrap/config tools.
acceptance: A canonical `/wiki` command path dispatches `bootstrap`, `status`, `resume`, and `config` subcommands, or Pi-equivalent registration proves those exact user command strings are available.
`/wiki bootstrap` starts CodeWiki in greenfield and brownfield repositories by calling setup/bootstrap backend functions directly, not by exposing a new normal agent tool.
`/wiki status` renders developer-facing health, active focus, next action, blockers, latest validation signal, automation-readiness summary, and source refs.
`/wiki resume` continues from CodeWiki source refs and last known stable state, preserving existing resume-context behavior.
`/wiki config` renders user CodeWiki preference/configuration choices for selection in the TUI.

Legacy `/wiki-bootstrap`, `/wiki-status`, `/wiki-resume`, `/wiki-config`, `/wiki-ui`, and `/audit` behavior remains as documented compatibility or deprecation shims until replacement coverage is validated.
README, command help, and source-contract snapshots reflect the canonical command surface and compatibility shims without treating low-level tools as user commands.
non_goals: Do not implement `/wiki system` or `/wiki product` navigation in this task.
Do not consolidate the internal six-tool agent API in this task.
Do not remove legacy commands before compatibility behavior and source-contract coverage exist.
Do not add dedicated `wiki_bootstrap`, `wiki_config`, or `wiki_project` normal agent tools.
verification: wiki_gate/task-close linters for source-contract, stale-reference, changed, and alignment

delta.desired: Canonical core `/wiki` command routing exists for bootstrap/status/resume/config, legacy shims remain documented, and bootstrap/config call backend functions directly.
delta.current: Current Pi adapter exposes hyphenated legacy commands and standalone compatibility surfaces, while accepted knowledge defines canonical `/wiki bootstrap`, `/wiki status`, `/wiki resume`, and `/wiki config`.
delta.closure: Task closes after command registration/routing, source-contract docs, compatibility shims, and command tests pass.
